source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Clutch and Transmissions, p.7-41

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic vacuum modulator checks
steps: Measure the gap between the other modulator's sleeve end and the gauge line; replace the suspect modulator if it is more than 1/16".
Sleeve alignment: roll the modulator body on a flat surface and watch whether the sleeve runs true to the can; if concentric with a free plunger, it is good.
A modulator that passes all of these tests should be reused.
